test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the summary of the passage.

options.text: There are serious issues that are stopping buyers from buying EVs
With the advent of EVs fuel-driven vehicles will disappear
EVs will come on Indian roads soon but cannot continue due to the electricity shortage
Though there are some issues, EVs will arrive on Indian roads soon, which is good for customers and for the earth

solution:
The correct answer is: **Though there are some issues, EVs will arrive on Indian roads soon, which is good for customers and for the earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This answer correctly summarizes the main idea of the passage.
 
• The passage discusses the increasing enthusiasm for electric vehicles, the rational reasons for buying
